title: French Door Curtain
text: French Door Curtain. This is a nice French door cover but the color I received is off. The color was more yellow than off white which is not what I was expecting according the image.

product_metadata.title: Turquoize Blackout French Door Curtains Tricia Window Door Curtains Thermal Insulated Door Curtain Panel 26W x 68L Privacy Door Shade Tricia Curtain for Door Window Curtains - 2 Panel, Dark Teal
features: SET OF 2 PANELS : Including 2 elegant panels. Each panel 26 inches width by 68 inches length. Add your house an classic and sophisticated look, thus you can easily blend these with your existing home décor

VERSATILE USE: These functional panels act as a beautiful shade from the sun and offer privacy. Panels can be let down for full privacy, or tied up to allow in natural light , providing a charming decorative addition to any windowed door
EASY HANGING: The tricia french door panels can be easily attached with velcro. Easy installation without any tool ,no curtain rod necessary. Perfect for living rooms, bedrooms, and even kitchens

AMAZING METERIAL: Made By 100% Polyester, natural effect, vinyl free and ECO friendly, the open weave solid textured embellishment provides a light and airy feel, make the perfect soft and luxurious touch
MACHINE WASHABLE: Easy cleaning and maintenance, just put it directly into washing machine with cold water, use only non-chlorine bleach when needed, tumble dry low and warm iron as needed
